title: generated clip standing in for an instrument
why: SYNTHETIC MEDIA, generated by Veo — see media/fraud/PROVENANCE.json. The most dangerous form of this attack, and the reason the corpus contains generated video at all: a clip submitted for the step that is supposed to end in a torque figure. The other two generated cases fail on identity alone; this one is what a technician who wants to skip a fastener would actually produce, and the clip deliberately keeps the wrench barrel out of frame so it carries no setting either. The Skeptic's job is unchanged — this belongs to no machine — and the architecture's answer to the rest is that `measured` is carried by a paired instrument and never by any photograph, generated or not.

marks: a single spiral cable wrap on the right fork leg, the left leg bare

job.procedure: Front brake service — Segway Xyber v3
